text: For a curve parametrized by arc length, the curvature kappa is defined as:
choices: the arc length between two nearby points
the magnitude |T'(s)| of the derivative of the unit tangent vector
the dot product T . N of the tangent and normal vectors
explanation: With arc-length parametrization, kappa = |dT/ds| measures how fast the unit tangent turns. Torsion measures out-of-plane twisting, a distinct quantity, and T . N = 0 always because the Frenet frame is orthonormal.
